goal: Migrate the existing browser/collect-xe-browser.js implementation to strict TypeScript, with a thin CommonJS wrapper preserving collect, resume, cancel, validatePageUrl and CLI diagnostic. Preserve exact existing behavior and all prior regressions: same-context navigation, persisted CAPTCHA/Retry-After, cancellation at actual active boundaries, progressive pagination, deduplication, atomic durable rows/checkpoints/export ordering and legacy imports. This is a behavior-preserving port, not a policy redesign. Use existing production types where possible and precise structural types for remaining JS boundaries; no any, suppressions or relaxed TS/lint. Ensure emitted dist/browser imports resolve actual root collectors/xe and collect-listings implementations correctly, not stale dist copies, and source wrapper and compiled exports work. Only necessary declaration/build/lint inclusion changes and new focused compiled-entrypoint tests are allowed beyond this module. Preserve old tests/helpers/dependencies/history/data and other source modules byte-for-byte. Existing tests already exercise extensive collection; reuse them without weakening or duplicating their implementation. Add focused proof for compiled module identity/import resolution and persisted successful traversal using existing offline boundaries, never replace collect/store with mocks. No live traffic, profiles, publication or deployment. Prove plain root npm ci then npm run check as separate commands in one genuinely fresh external /tmp copy recursively excluding node_modules, dist, .git and all .atoma* paths. No browser install may mask root-only test dependencies. Regenerate collector dist JS/map from TS so those previously stale outputs become reproducible. Record results once, avoid repeating passing full suites absent changes, and clean disposable temporary dependency copies after preserving probe evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: browser/collect-xe-browser runs from strict TypeScript with compatible exports and behavior, and plain npm ci then npm run check pass in one fresh copy.
